title: MC Create Nexus
description: Minecraft modpack focused on Create — a complete set for exploring and automating mechanisms.
body:
# Welcome to **Minecraft Create Nexus**!

![Welcome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c7b1cb9eeda6f26c0dff49dcf93000e4e4e75772.png)

---

I created this modpack to make it easier for players who want to focus on the **Create** theme and related mechanisms to choose mods.  
I carefully gathered all the most useful and proven mods that complement the main **Create** mod and help make the gameplay more **convenient** and **interesting**.

---

## What’s inside this pack?

- **Create** mod and addons  
- Additional mods that simplify the creation and management of mechanisms  
- Tools that make automation more accessible and user-friendly  

All mods are **carefully selected** to work harmoniously together without causing unnecessary conflicts or difficulties.

---

## Important Note

> **This modpack is NOT designed for a regular Minecraft playthrough.**  
> It is created so that players can **fully utilize their skills** and truly experience the modpack itself.  
>  
> Therefore, there are **no mods for biomes, weapons, or unrelated content** included.  
> This pack is made **exclusively for exploring and fully utilizing the Create mod**.

---

## My goal

I want you to be able to immediately dive into building and developing your projects without wasting time on searching for and testing different mods.  
This pack contains all the essential tools and improvements to help you quickly and easily bring your ideas to life, while maintaining the authentic atmosphere and style of the original **Create** mod.

---

## Final words

I hope **Minecraft Create Nexus** becomes a stable and convenient platform for your creativity and experiments with mechanisms.  

---

*Thank you for choosing Minecraft Create Nexus!*
